systems.platform: tablets, centralised databases and identification platforms, unnamed
systems.owner: Agence nationale d'identification des personnes (Anip), with the Wuri project and Unicef
systems.tiers: ten pilot public hospitals since August 2025, staffed by Anip agents; not at the mairie

note: The birth-registration counters are run by a national agency's own agents inside ten hospitals, so the remark that internet quality matters there is about a central service point; the mairie is named only as where parents used to go, and nothing is stated about its connection.
